This inspection is at the request of S. Aldakhil, owner in response to a permit suspension on 10/7/26 for a rodent infestation. The conditions causing the permit suspension were not observed to be corrected. Your permit to operate is not reinstated. 

On this date, the followings were observed:
- rodent droppings and sunflower seed shells below shelves throughout the customer service aisle
- rodent droppings in the candy boxes 
- rodent droppings in front of beverage fridge and candy aisle
- hole above the air curtain ceiling tile
- hole above the emergency exit door in the first storage room
- hole on the ceiling above the metal rack near 2-compartment sink in the first storage room


(1) Continue to eliminate all evidence of rodents  
(2) Seal gaps greater than 1/4 inch with sturdy materials (i.e. dry wall, silicon, cement, etc.)
(3) Clean and sanitize the affected area

Contact this office at 714-433-6000 or at the number noted on this report, during normal days of business to request a re-inspection, or if you have any questions. If you are calling after 5:00 pm or on weekends, leave a message at (714) 433-6419 and an inspector/on call staff will call you back at their earliest convenience. The purpose of this visit was to conduct a second reinspection due to the temporary health permit suspension noted on the routine inspection report dated 10/06/2026 at the request of the Owner.

On this date, live cockroach activity was observed in the dry storage area and next to the walk-in cooler. The facility remained closed due to this reason. Refer to violations #24 and #50.

The facility received pest control services on 10/07/2026 after the noted closure.

Ensure there is no cockroach activity prior to requesting a reinspection. Re-opening requirements were discussed with owner.

A "CLOSED" seal was posted.

Note: 2nd or greater reinspection are charged $32.00 per quarter hour or fraction thereof during normal business hours, and $48.00 per quarter hour outside of normal business hours.

This inspection is at the request of T. Mai, manager in response to a permit suspension on 9/15/26 for a cockroach and rodent infestation. The conditions causing the permit suspension were not observed to be corrected. Your permit to operate is not reinstated.  

The followings were observed on this date:
- several dead cockroaches on the glass shelves, inside the plastic wrap of unuse equipment in the front, wall behind the metal rack stored behind the counter, crevices on the counter and corner of wooden boards below the counter.
- rodent droppings were observed in the left storage room below the wooden table and on the counter in the front. 
- gap greater than 1/4inch were observed on the corner of ceilings and wall pipes in the left storage room, crevices on the counter, and base board below the mop sink in the middle storage room. 

(1) Continue to eliminate all evidence of cockroaches.
(2) Seal around the ceiling tiles and wall with crevices or gaps throughout the facility. 
Contact this office at 714-433-6000 or at the number noted on this report, during normal days of business to request a re-inspection, or if you have any questions. If you are calling after 5:00 pm or on weekends, leave a message at (714) 433-6419 and an inspector/on call staff will call you back at their earliest convenience. Please make after hour request calls before 8:00 pm. The afterhours overtime rate through June 30, 2027, is $48 per quarter hour, or fraction thereof; time charged includes all travel time.

Pest control receipts were provided and serviced on 9/16/26.

This visit was at the request of Rami Barson, the person in charge, after permit suspension on 10/7/26 for rodent infestation. The purpose of this visit was to verify that rodent activity was effectively eliminated. 
At the time of inspection, still observed some old evidence of rodent activity in the rear storage area and office. Refer to violation 24. The evidence of rodent activity was removed during the inspection. Continue with approved pest control measures and regularly monitor all areas of the facility.  Properly seal up the hole on the ceiling in the office. Refer to violation 44. A 1-week reinspection is scheduled to verify continue compliance. Your permit is hereby reinstated.
